texts.orig: Unfortunately;   conventional  speculative execution typi cally provides a limited performance improvement because only small number of instructions can be speculatively executed. One reason for this limitation is that conventional speculative   execution is typically  performed at the basic block level, and basic blocks tend to include only small number of instructions. Another reason is that conventional hardware structures used to perform speculative execution can only accommodate small number of   speculative instructions_

texts.orig: One challenge in designing a system that supports specu lative execution is to detect a rollback condition. A rollback condition can occur in a number of situations. For example_ rollback condition occurs when a speculative thread that is executing program instructions in advance of a head thread reads from memory element before the head thread performs write to the memory element. In this case, the speculative thread must "rollback so that it can read the value stored by the head thread. A rollback condition can be detected by "marking memory elements as are read by the speculative  thread so that the head thread can subse 10   quently determine if the memory elements have been read by the speculative thread. texts.orig: SUMMARY
texts.text: SUMMARY

texts.label: text
texts.orig: One embodiment of   the present   invention   provides system that facilitates marking of objects defined within an object-oriented programming   system to   keep track of accesses to fields within the objects The system operates by receiving reference to field within an object, and identifying a marking bit within the object that is associated with the field. Note that each marking bit within the object is associated with different subset of fields within the object. Next, the system sets the marking bit to indicate that at least one field within the associated subset of fields has been referenced. Finally; the system performs the reference to the field.

Note that each marking bit within the object is associated with different subset of fields within the object. Next, the system sets the marking bit to indicate that at least one field within the associated subset of fields has been referenced. Finally; the system performs the reference to the field.

The head thread accesses primary version of the object and the speculative thread accesses space-time dimensioned version of the marking bit and setting the marking bit take place for a read operation by the speculative thread.
